chunks: ʿUmar ibn Udhaynah narrated from Zurārah, from Abī Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:

There is nothing due on fewer than five camels. When they are five, then one sheep is due on them up to ten. When they are ten, then two sheep are due on them. When they reach fifteen, then three sheep from the flock are due on them. When they reach twenty, then four sheep from the flock are due on them. When they reach twenty-five, then five sheep from the flock are due on them. When they increase by one, then a bint makhāḍ is due on them up to thirty-five. If he does not have a bint makhāḍ, then an ibn labūn male. When they increase beyond thirty-five by one, then a bint labūn is due on them up to forty-five. When they increase by one, then a ḥiqqah is due on them, and it was only called ḥiqqah because it has become entitled for its back to be ridden, up to sixty. If they increase by one, then a jadhaʿah is due on them up to seventy-five. If they increase by one, then two bint labūns are due on them up to ninety. If they increase by one, then two ḥiqqahs are due up to one hundred and twenty. If they increase beyond one hundred and twenty by one, then for every fifty a ḥiqqah is due, and for every forty a bint labūn.

key_terms.ابْنَةُ لَبُونٍ: a female camel in its third year due at the next threshold
key_terms.ابْنَةُ مَخَاضٍ: a female camel in its second year due at twenty-six camels
key_terms.ابْنُ لَبُونٍ: a male camel accepted as a substitute when bint makhāḍ is unavailable
key_terms.الْإِبِلِ: camels, the livestock category discussed for zakat
key_terms.الْغَنَمِ: sheep, used here as the due payment at several lower levels
key_terms.جَذَعَةٌ: a more mature she-camel due at the subsequent threshold
key_terms.حِقَّةٌ: a she-camel old enough to be ridden, due at a higher threshold
key_terms.شَاةٌ: one sheep due as zakat at the lower camel thresholds

ai.seo_question: What is the zakat due on camels at each number threshold in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith sets out the legal thresholds and required amounts of zakat on camels in a precise graduated schedule. It is an important fiqh text for livestock zakat, detailing both the minimum nisab and the specific animal due at each level.
